meta.title: BD-LawAssist
meta.description: Legal research for Bangladesh law: ask questions, verify sections, analyse case documents.

home.title: Bangladesh law, in plain words
home.subtitle: Answers to legal questions, every claim cited to the statute text.

fir.title: FIR details
fir.ambiguousTime: It isn't clear whether this is morning or night.
